verdict.rationale: Built-in operational AI is a fair question for a banking-as-a-service platform, so the axis applies. The evidence covers customer, account, card and payment APIs, KYC/KYB verification, webhooks, EDD, case notifications, and a centralized ops platform. None of it mentions natural-language transaction search, AI-drafted dispute or alert responses, or anomaly summaries. The ops tooling and case management are adjacent features and earn no credit.
